question: Which clusters increase steadily from week 2 to week 13 in cheese A, and which decrease?
dashboard_actions: Select all clusters; read the mean line of each facet in the pattern plot for A_1..A_5
expected_answer_form: list of cluster ids per direction
notes: Expected to recover the Bacillota-early / Pseudomonadota-late succession reported by Smith et al.

question: Which clusters peak in the middle of ripening (around A_3, week 6) rather than at the start or end?
dashboard_actions: Select all clusters; look for facets with a hump at A_3

question: At which week does each cluster reach its maximum in cheese A, and is it the same week in cheese C?
dashboard_actions: Read the x position of the peak for A_* and C_* separately in each facet
expected_answer_form: table cluster x (peak week A, peak week C)

question: Which clusters have a similar shape to the cluster that is most enriched for Actinomycetota?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota as functional annotation, note the greenest node, brush several nodes and compare facets
expected_answer_form: cluster ids plus a short shape description
notes: Vignette: groups 10 and 3 for cheese A peak at A_4/A_5

question: Are there clusters whose cheese A and cheese C halves have opposite shapes (up in A, down in C)?
dashboard_actions: Compare the A_* and C_* portions of each facet

question: In which cluster do the different phyla (line colours) disagree most, i.e. the ribbons are widest or the mean lines diverge?
dashboard_actions: Select all; compare ribbon width and line separation per facet
expected_answer_form: cluster id and the phyla involved

question: Which cluster has the tightest ribbon, meaning its features follow almost the same trajectory?
dashboard_actions: Select all; compare min-max ribbon widths

question: For Pseudomonadota, what are the dominant temporal shapes among the clusters that carry most of its features?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; brush the two or three greenest nodes; describe their facets

question: For Bacillota, which clusters hold most of its features and do they decline over ripening?
dashboard_actions: Select Bacillota; brush the greenest nodes; check the mean lines
expected_answer_form: cluster ids and yes/no with trend

question: For Bacteroidota, is there a single dominant pattern or are its features spread across many clusters?
dashboard_actions: Select Bacteroidota; compare node colours across the network
expected_answer_form: answer plus distribution of node colours

question: Within the clusters enriched for Actinomycetota, which classes (Actinomycetes, others) make up the stacked bar?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; brush greenest nodes; read the stacked bar legend and segments

question: For Pseudomonadota, how is the Gammaproteobacteria / Betaproteobacteria / Alphaproteobacteria split different between its top clusters?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; brush top nodes; compare stacked bars per cluster

question: Which individual contigs (3rd level) in the most Actinomycetota-enriched cluster have KEGG annotations?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; brush the greenest node; filter the table to Actinomycetota; page through KEGG_ID
expected_answer_form: list of IDs with KEGG links

question: How many features with an unknown phylum fall into each cluster, and do they follow any particular shape?
dashboard_actions: Select 'Unknown' as functional annotation; read node colours; brush the greenest

question: Given Pseudomonadota, which cluster has the most features and what is its pattern?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; identify the greenest node; brush it

question: Given Pseudomonadota and restricting to Gammaproteobacteria, does the dominant cluster change?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; select Gammaproteobacteria in Taxonomic Scope; compare stacked bars across brushed clusters

question: Given Bacillota and class Bacilli versus Clostridia, do the two classes sit in the same clusters?
dashboard_actions: Select Bacillota; toggle Bacilli then Clostridia in Taxonomic Scope; compare stacked bars

question: Given Pseudomonadota and Gammaproteobacteria, which contigs carry Type VI secretion KEGG orthologs and which cluster are they in?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; select Gammaproteobacteria; search the table for secretion KO ids; read the cluster column
expected_answer_form: list of IDs, KO ids and cluster
notes: Smith et al. report Type VI secretion enrichment in Pseudomonadota (Psychrobacter)

question: Given Actinomycetota and Actinomycetes, how many contigs have a GO annotation at all, and which cluster holds most of them?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; select Actinomycetes; use the table row count and GO_ID column

question: Where do the Type IV secretion genes (KEGG) fall, and do they share one cluster?
dashboard_actions: Set table filter to all annotations; search for the Type IV KO ids; read the cluster column
notes: Vignette: 12 of 13 Type IV secretion genes were in Group 9, peaking at C_5

question: Which cluster contains a specific contig ID of interest, and what are its neighbours in the network?
dashboard_actions: Search the table for the ID; note the cluster; locate the node and its edges

question: Which cluster pairs remain connected when the importance score is raised to its maximum?
dashboard_actions: Move the slider to the right end; list remaining edges

question: At the lowest importance score, which clusters are still isolated (no edges at all)?
dashboard_actions: Move the slider to 0; find nodes without edges

question: For Actinomycetota, are its most enriched clusters connected to the rest of the network or isolated?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; read the edges of the greenest nodes at the default score and at a lower score
notes: Vignette: no edges to groups 10 and 3 (cheese A); groups 2 and 5 highly connected (cheese C)

question: Does switching to the circle layout make it easier to see which clusters form a connected component?
dashboard_actions: Switch layout to circle; count components visually

question: Using the grid layout, brush the top row of nodes: what do those clusters have in common in the pattern plot?
dashboard_actions: Switch to grid; brush the first row; compare facets

question: Drag the three most connected nodes together and brush them: do they share a dominant phylum?
dashboard_actions: Drag nodes; brush; read pattern plot colours and stacked bars

question: Select only the clusters connected to the strongest edge: how do their shapes relate (same direction, lagged, opposite)?
dashboard_actions: Hover edges for weights; click the two end nodes; compare facets

question: For the same cluster, how does the cheese C trajectory differ from the cheese A trajectory?
dashboard_actions: Read the A_* half and C_* half of a facet
notes: C has no C_2 sample so the C half has four points

question: How do the two clusters most enriched for Pseudomonadota differ in class composition and shape?
dashboard_actions: Select Pseudomonadota; brush the two greenest nodes; compare stacked bar and facets

question: Do Flavobacteriia (Bacteroidota) and Bacilli (Bacillota) peak at different weeks?
dashboard_actions: Select each phylum in turn; restrict Taxonomic Scope; compare facets of the enriched clusters

question: How many features does each cluster contain, and which is the largest?
dashboard_actions: Select all; read bar lengths in the stacked bar

question: What fraction of the features in the largest cluster are Gammaproteobacteria?
dashboard_actions: Brush the largest cluster; compare the Gammaproteobacteria segment to the bar length

question: Rank the clusters by number of Actinomycetota features.
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; order nodes by colour, or brush all and read the table filter counts

question: Which cluster has the most edges at the default importance score?
dashboard_actions: Count edges per node

question: Which edge has the highest weight, and what are the two clusters' patterns?
dashboard_actions: Hover edges for weights; brush the two nodes

question: How many connected components does the network have at the default score?
dashboard_actions: Inspect the network; optionally switch to circle layout

question: What molecular function does the most common KEGG ortholog in the Actinomycetota-enriched cluster have?
dashboard_actions: Brush the cluster; open the KEGG link in the table
notes: Needs the external link; the dashboard only shows the id

question: Which GO terms recur among contigs in a cluster that peaks at C_5?
dashboard_actions: Brush the cluster; scan the GO_ID column; open QuickGO links

question: How many features in the selected clusters lack a GO annotation, and does this vary by cluster?
dashboard_actions: Brush clusters; compare table rows with empty GO_ID cells
notes: In the raw data 82230/86156 rows have KEGG ids but only 34571 have GO ids

question: When the Taxonomic Scope is restricted to one class, how many features disappear from the pattern plot?
dashboard_actions: Compare table row counts with and without the taxa filter

question: Are the Actinomycetota features that peak late in cheese A following an independent succession, given their clusters are not connected to others?
dashboard_actions: Select Actinomycetota; inspect edges and facets
notes: Vignette's own hypothesis; the dashboard shows evidence but cannot confirm causation

question: Is the rise of secretion-system genes at C_5 associated with the higher taxonomic diversity of that sample?
dashboard_actions: Search secretion KO ids; brush their cluster; compare stacked bar diversity
